description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10 (net10.0), converting the legacy non-SDK-style project file to SDK-style format to enable modern Azure SDK usage and cloud-native deployment.
tasks.reason: .NET Framework 4.8 is outside the mainstream support path and cannot reliably consume modern Azure SDK (Azure.*) packages. Upgrading to .NET 10 is required before any Azure service migrations can be performed.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade target framework from .NET Framework 4.8 (net482) to .NET 10 (net10.0). Convert the legacy MSBuild project file (ContosoUniversity.csproj) to SDK-style format. Migrate from packages.config to PackageReference. Ensure the ASP.NET MVC 5 application can run on .NET 10 (migrate to ASP.NET Core MVC if needed). The project must build successfully and all existing unit tests must pass after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Migrate the application's SQL Server database connection to Azure SQL Database using Managed Identity (passwordless authentication), removing hard-coded connection strings.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses a LocalDB connection string with Integrated Security. Moving to Azure SQL Database with Managed Identity eliminates credentials from configuration and aligns with cloud security best practices.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Entity Framework Core database context (SchoolContext) to connect to Azure SQL Database using Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential / passwordless authentication). Remove or replace the hard-coded connection string in Web.config / appsettings. The application must build and all unit tests must pass after migration.

tasks.description: Migrate the MSMQ-based notification queue service (NotificationService using System.Messaging) to Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.reason: MSMQ (System.Messaging) is a Windows-only technology not available in cloud/containerized environments. Azure Service Bus provides a cloud-native, scalable messaging solution with Managed Identity support.
tasks.requirements: Replace the System.Messaging / MSMQ implementation in NotificationService with Azure Service Bus SDK. Use Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) for authentication. Preserve the existing send/receive notification semantics. Remove the NotificationQueuePath app setting and replace with Azure Service Bus connection configuration. The application must build and all unit tests must pass after migration.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment.
tasks.reason: The project uses several older package versions (e.g., Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 3.1.32, Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 2.1.4, Microsoft.Identity.Client 4.21.1) that may have known CVEs. Security remediation must be completed before the application is considered production-ready.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
